notes: NEW Look it up (Study tab): type any word or topic — or select a word in Your material, or tap a key term after generating a pack — and get a real dictionary entry (pronunciation you can play, part of speech, definitions, examples, similar words) plus a short Wikipedia summary with a link to the full article. One tap adds the definition to your material so it lands in your next study pack. Only the term you look up is sent (to the Free Dictionary and Wikipedia), never your notes; offline it says so plainly.
Fixed the update box on phones: the Got it / Update buttons sat beside the notes and squeezed them into a narrow column. They now sit underneath at full width, and long notes scroll inside the box.
